snippet.title: Order: The New Dawn Launches October 14
snippet.description:
Hi everyone, sorry to keep you waiting!

After a long period of preparation and refinement, Order:The New Dawn is finally about to meet you all!

The EA version of Order:The New Dawn will officially launch on October 14 and will be available on Steam. It will be priced at $24.99 on Steam. We look forward to meeting you in the United Galaxy and embarking on a new adventure together!
